title: Dispatch error event
description: The Sentry-compatible event posted to the Dispatch error-ingest endpoint (POST {error_endpoint}, default /api/v1/store). This is the canonical shape every Dispatch SDK must produce. Derived from the dispatch-rails reference producer (EventBuilder). Server SDKs (ruby/python/node/...) and the browser SDK (javascript) both validate against this schema; fields that only one surface emits are marked below.

event_id.description: UUID v4 with the hyphens removed (32 lowercase hex chars).

timestamp.description: Seconds since the Unix epoch, as a float (e.g. Time.now.to_f / Date.now()/1000).

platform.description: Originating runtime. Drives in_app heuristics and dashboard grouping.

environment.description: Resolved environment (config.environment, else the framework env). Never null.

release.description: Release identifier, e.g. a git SHA. Optional.

server_name.description: Hostname of the reporting server. Server SDKs only; omitted in the browser.

transaction.description: The request handler, 'controller#action' style. Omitted for background/job errors and in the browser.

values.description: The exception and its cause chain, OLDEST CAUSE FIRST, the raised exception LAST (Sentry ordering). Capped at MAX_CAUSES.

tags.description: Flat string→string map. Derived keys (request_id, transaction) plus the host app's tags; explicit tags win on conflict.

sdk.description: Identifies the producing SDK. Server SDKs set this; the browser tracker omits it (the X-Dispatch-Sdk header carries it instead).

breadcrumbs.description: Browser SDK only. A ring buffer of recent UI/console/navigation events leading up to the error.

user_path.description: Browser SDK only. The last few click labels, oldest→newest — a concise path to the error.

handled.description: false for unhandled (middleware/global handler) captures, true for manual capture_exception.

frames.description: Frames OLDEST FIRST, the failing frame LAST (Sentry ordering). Capped at MAX_FRAMES.

abs_path.description: Absolute path / URL of the source.

filename.description: Path relative to the project root.

colno.description: Column. Browser SDK provides this; server SDKs typically omit it.

in_app.description: True when the frame is the app's own code (not a dependency/stdlib). Per-language heuristic: ruby excludes /gems//vendor//ruby/; js excludes node_modules; python excludes site-packages/stdlib.

pre_context.description: Up to CONTEXT_LINES source lines before context_line. Added to in-app frames (server SDKs with filesystem access). Limited to MAX_CONTEXT_FRAMES frames per event.

post_context.description: Up to CONTEXT_LINES source lines after context_line.

headers.description: Allow-listed headers only (User-Agent, Referer, Accept, Content-Type, Host, X-Request-Id).

data.description: Opt-in (send_default_params). Filtered request params, or {"_truncated": true} when over MAX_PARAMS_BYTES.
